question:
From the options given below choose the synonym (similar meaning) of the word:

Equivocal
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Ambiguous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Equivocal"** means something that is open to more than one interpretation; not having one clear or definite meaning. (अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **The politician gave an equivocal answer, avoiding a direct response to the question.
 
 

 
• **"Ambiguous"** refers to something that can be understood in more than one way; not clear or decided. (संदिग्ध)
 
 
• **Example: **The instructions she left were ambiguous and caused a lot of confusion.</l
